profile.headline: Marketing
profile.summary:
As a marketing professional with extensive online and digital experience I have spent the last seven years working in a number of management, marketing, branding, graphic design and advertising capacities.

As the current Digital Marketing Manager for Florida A&M University Marching 100, Drumline Live Entertainment Group, I provide outreach to various online outlets, monitor campaign statistics and analyze data.

positions.title: Founder
positions.description: NoteCloud Network (Fine Art's Social Audition Network) is a social website that charges Dance, Chorus, Band, Orchestra, and Theater high school graduates (over 600,000 students) a $25 fee to audition to any college and or university online! This concept saves a ton of money for all parties involved (students, parents, schools etc.) and gives college and university scholarship recruiters a rare advantage to promote the program and institution in one central convenient location.

positions.title: Webmaster & Marketing Communications Specialist ("Marching 100")
positions.description:
Known nationally and internationally for its high-energy, high-stepping precision in marching, spirited showmanship, dance routines, and innovative performances, the Florida A&M University Marching Band, is acclaimed nationwide as one of the best collegiate marching bands in America.
 
The famed marching band, widely-known as “The Marching 100,” has been featured in films, documentaries, commercials, and numerous publications. The band has been featured in segments on “60 Minutes,” (CBS); “P.M. Magazine,” (NBC); “20/20,” (ABC), the “CBS Evening News,” and in Sports Illustrated. Similarly, the band has performed in five NFL Super Bowls, six Honda Battle of the Bands Invitational Showcases, and three presidential inaugural parades.

positions.title: Webmaster & Marketing Communications Specialist (Contract)
positions.locationName: United States of America | Atlanta, Georgia
positions.description: Erin Robinson has toured internationally in Japan and South Korea as a professional musician with DRUMLINE LIVE. He later in 2016 became the web designer of DRUMLINE LIVE’s digital platforms. The energetic cast has honed its precision and energy with years of training in marching band programs across the southern United States.

positions.title: Webmaster/Web Developer (Contract)
positions.description: Atlanta Premier Production is your event production partner. We don’t want to just set you up with the best audio, visual and lighting equipment and send you on your way. We want to help you imagine. We want to help you design. We want to help you perform. And because we’re a privately-owned and operated young and resourceful company, we have the ability to make anything happen – big or small.

positions.title: Senior Webmaster/ Marketing Specialist (Contract)
positions.description: Here at I.T. Savvy Consulting, we are dedicated to you and all your business management needs. Our team of talented professionals has over 100 years of experience.  We have launched several successful projects, but our most important goal is to make our clients successful and life-long customers.

positions.title: Director Marketing Communications & Webmaster (Contract)
positions.description:
Great Day Home Care is licensed by the Georgia Department of Human Resources Office of Regulatory Services, to provide skilled nursing care services as well as personal senior home care services. Whatever the situation may be, preserving the dignity of our clients is essential, and our number one priority.
 
At Great Day, we work very closely with the client and their family or custodian to be informed and have understanding of the unique personality and preferences of the client while providing excellent senior home care services. We are diligent in our effort to respect the personal wishes of our clients.

positions.title: Webmaster - Digital Marketing Engineer
positions.description: Watkins is a member of the prestigious American Bandmasters Association, the FAMU Gallery of Distinguished Alumni, the Bands of America Hall of Fame and the Phi Beta Mu Georgia Bandmasters Hall of Fame.  He has received 16 Certificates of Excellence from the National Band Association and is the recipient of the Edwin Franko Goldman Award, Sudler Order of Merit, Legion of Honor Award, and the Turnett LeadershipCharacter Award.  He holds the unique distinction of having led bands that received the John Philip Sousa Foundation’s Sudler Flag of Honor, Sudler Shield, and Sudler Silver Scroll Awards.

positions.locationName: Stephenson High School | Stone Mountain, Georgia

positions.title: Percussion Director
positions.description: It is the mission of the Stephenson High School Band program to foster an appreciation of good music, to create a positive camaraderie for the students and community, and to build model citizens through participation in music rehearsals and performances. Students are offered musical training via Concert Band, Symphonic Band, Wind Ensemble, Jazz Band, Marching Band, Instrumental Ensembles, and Advanced Placement Music Theory.

It is part of the Gwinnett County Public Schools system, one of the 15 largest public school systems in the country. South Gwinnett is home to about 2,800 students.

positions.title: Senior Marketing Communications Specialist (Contract)
positions.description:
Development and implementation of the Brand strategy. Developing the marketing strategy for new and existing products. Overseeing implementation of the Marketing strategy - including campaigns, events, digital marketing, and PR.

At PP&A®, our philosophy is simple. Remove the tasks that cost your business time and money and focus on the things that increase revenue, promote growth and ensure the profitability and success of your organization. PP&A is a privately held entity and is led by an executive team that hails from professional employer organizations, corporate human resources, accounting and insurance firms.
